name: Netori A Live
source:
NTL A LIVE is a multiverse project game centered around NTL (netori, the opposite of ntr, MC taking someone else's girls). The first world is the universe of DATE A LIVE, play as the MC corrupting Shido's harem while Shido is busy saving spirits and the world.

[From [url=https://ulith-dev.itch.io/ntl]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
NTL A LIVE是一款以NTL（netori，ntr的对立面，MC抢走别人的女孩）为中心的多元宇宙项目游戏。第一个世界是《约会大作战》的宇宙，扮演MC腐蚀士道的后宫，而士道则忙着拯救灵魂和世界。

[来自[url=https://ulith-dev.itch.io/ntl]itch.io[/url]]
